map_construction.A_target: shuffle cues 0..7 with seed plus 101, then assign four zeros and four ones
map_construction.B_local_target: shuffle cues 0..7 with seed plus 202, then assign four zeros and four ones

row_construction.B_calibration: each B cue repeats sixteen times with its local target; A is absent
row_construction.main_training: Cartesian product of eight A cues, eight B cues, two forced A actions, two forced B actions, repeated twice
row_construction.development: Cartesian product of eight A cues and eight B cues, repeated twice; actions are model-selected
row_construction.training_order: deterministic seed-specific shuffle after complete factorial construction
row_construction.development_order: deterministic seed-specific shuffle after complete factorial construction
row_construction.source_event: SHA-256 namespace, phase, seed, original row index and source tag before target lookup
row_construction.outcome_id: SHA-256 namespace, phase, seed, original row index and outcome tag before target lookup
row_construction.global_success: one iff forced B action equals A target XOR B local target
row_construction.B_auxiliary_label_release: only after the forced B action, through B-local outcome API
